oracle_script: import marshal, sys; code = compile(sys.stdin.read(), sys.argv[1], 'exec', dont_inherit=True, optimize=0); sys.stdout.buffer.write(marshal.dumps(code))
filter: Subtract source-derived static and compiler-initialized strings and cached single-character strings; omit environment-specific absolute interpreter installation filenames.
capture_protocol: Stop the owned isolated interpreter at Py_CompileStringObject entry using a hardware execution breakpoint, before parsing empty exec source with optimize=0. Read both intern tables externally twice, require unchanged executable/header/runtime bytes and equal observed/unobserved marshal output. Preserve the stopped memory for an offline canonical-pointer ownership audit; perform no Python diagnostics or C API calls in the observed process.

retention.scope: Canonical strings remain owned by the fixed bootstrap throughout compilation. This is not a model of later caller mutations, custom import hooks or warning callbacks.
roots: initialized immutable builtin and extension type dictionaries
